limits: No controls, installed imports, live calls, worker runs, services, configuration, or model requests were executed for this publication.
Control projections are review material requiring private graph dependencies; they are not a portable runnable test suite.
Main repository modules and existing tests are older development source; these analysis files do not integrate Source156 into the installer.
Installed source/native acceptance, permanent service operation, worker capability acceptance, and user semantics remain separate facts.
No new installed156 user PASS is claimed. F03 R4 remains no-send/NOT_RUN.
projection_rules: Exact pinned source and installed file hashes checked before projection.
Only string literal contents and comments are redacted; executable AST structure equals original after string-constant normalization.
Private absolute /home paths, including credential/config/evidence references, are replaced completely.
Concrete UUID and 32-hex identifiers, Telegram/account numeric identifiers, and non-loopback private IPv4 addresses are replaced.
Replacement symbol is category plus first 12 hex digits of SHA-256 of original literal fragment; no reverse mapping is public.
Public source integrity hashes remain for provenance; redacted bindings and absent private closure supply no live authority.
A leading analysis-only comment intentionally makes every public projection differ from installed bytes.
